synopsis.native: À la suite d'une tentative de suicide, un jeune biologiste influençable se retrouve embrigadé dans une organisation criminelle basée sur les hauteurs de Nice. L'apprenti serrurier qui lui a sauvé la vie, entre-temps devenu son ami, tente de l'arracher aux griffes de l'Arche des Loups...
synopsis.english: After a suicide attempt, a young and easily influenced biologist is recruited by a criminal organization based in the hills above Nice. The apprentice locksmith who saved his life becomes his friend and tries to pull him away from the claws of the Wolves' Ark...
